newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo steelers May output dropped on April.
newsitem.headline: Yugo steelers May output dropped on April.

text.p: Production in Yugoslavia's Smederevo and Niksic steel plants in May dropped against the previous month, Tanjug news agency said on Thursday.
In May Smederevo steel works produced 2,079 tonnes and Niksic 1,051 tonnes less steel than the same month in 1996, the agency quoted Yugoslav Iron and Steel Federation report.
"Damage in the rolling mill furnace in Smederevo as well as difficulties in supplying raw materials and sale are the main reasons for drop in production," the Federation said.
But cumulative January-May output stood at 395,860 tonnes of crude steel, up 169 percent against the same five months in 1996.
Smederevo increased its five months output to 353,114 tonnes, 251,901 tonnes up on January-May 1996.
Production in Niksic plant in the first five months dropped by 3,326 tonnes to 42,746 tonnes against the same period last year.
Cumulative January-May production of finished steel products stood at 396,477 tonnes, up 208,577 tonnes or 111 percent on the same period in 1996.
Some 274,000 tonnes of finished steel products was sold abroad due to reduced demand at home, the Federation said.
At the same time, Yugoslavia imported 59,000 tonnes of finished steel products. The imports fell by 27 percent against January-May period in 1996. -- Gordana Kukic, Belgrade Newsroom +381 11 222 4254
